# NEW 2026-11-18 territory rework (INNER). Generated by gen_territory_inner.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope. Imperial Authority change, kept within 0..100.
oe_ti_auth = { international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = $amount$ } clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 } } }

# Theme scope. Influence for the house of a house-born strategos (gen_theme_houses.py, var oe_tg_house).
oe_ti_house_inf = { if = { limit = { var:oe_tg_house ?= 1 } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_1 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 1 amount = $amount$ } } } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tg_house ?= 2 } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_2 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 2 amount = $amount$ } } } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tg_house ?= 3 } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_3 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 3 amount = $amount$ } } } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tg_house ?= 4 } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_4 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 4 amount = $amount$ } } } } }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. frontier
# Theme scope. Becomes a march and remembers it was a heartland province. A march cannot follow the civil course (4.1).
oe_ti_make_frontier = {
    oe_ts_set_status = { status = 2 }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ts_course_civil = yes oe_theme_convertible_trigger = yes capital = { owner = c:BYZ } }
        oe_ta_set_course = { course = army }
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_focus_cd years = 5 }
    }
    set_variable = oe_ti_origin_core
    set_variable = { name = oe_ti_quiet value = 0 }
    oe_ti_weak_front_clear = yes
    remove_variable = oe_ti_front_refused
    remove_variable = oe_ti_q_front
}
# Theme scope. Insufficient frontier defence (a heartland province on the border that stays a heartland province).
oe_ti_weak_front_apply = {
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ti_weak_front years = -1 mode = replace }
    every_owned_foreign_building_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ti_weak_front_loc months = 13 mode = replace } }
}
oe_ti_weak_front_clear = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ti_weak_front }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_ti_weak_front
        every_owned_foreign_building_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } remove_location_modifier = oe_ti_weak_front_loc }
    }
}
oe_ti_refuse_frontier = {
    oe_ti_weak_front_apply = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_ti_front_refused years = 5 }
    remove_variable = oe_ti_q_front
}
# Theme scope. A core-origin march returns to the heartland.
oe_ti_restore_core = {
    oe_ts_set_status = { status = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ti_quiet value = 0 }
    remove_variable = oe_ti_q_quiet
}
# Theme scope, every January.
oe_ti_front_check = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ti_borders_foreign = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ti_quiet value = 0 }
        remove_variable = oe_ti_q_quiet
        if = {
            limit = { oe_ts_core = yes }
            if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { is_ai = yes } } oe_ti_make_frontier = yes }
            else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ti_front_refused } } set_variable = oe_ti_q_front }
            else = { oe_ti_weak_front_apply = yes }
        }
    }
    else = {
        oe_ti_weak_front_clear = yes
        remove_variable = oe_ti_front_refused
        remove_variable = oe_ti_q_front
        if = {
            limit = { oe_ts_frontier = yes has_variable = oe_ti_origin_core }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ti_quiet } } set_variable = { name = oe_ti_quiet value = 0 } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_ti_quiet add = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_ti_quiet var:oe_ti_quiet >= 5 }
                if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { is_ai = yes } } oe_ti_restore_core = yes }
                else = { set_variable = oe_ti_q_quiet }
            }
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 2. Roman law (senate issue 4)
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_ti_law_theme is the theme. Authority is paid on submission, whatever the vote.
oe_ti_law_request = {
    oe_ti_auth = { amount = -5 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ti_target value = scope:oe_ti_law_theme }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ti_law_lock months = 6 }
    scope:oe_ti_law_theme = { set_variable = { name = oe_ti_law_pending months = 6 } }
    oe_tsn_request = { issue = 4 }
}
# BYZ scope. Contract (SENATE): the senate passed issue 4, or the emperor forced it through.
oe_tsn_apply_4 = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ti_target ?= { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } }
        var:oe_ti_target = {
            oe_ts_set_status = { status = 1 }
            set_variable = oe_ti_origin_core
            set_variable = { name = oe_ti_quiet value = 0 }
            remove_variable = oe_ti_law_pending
            oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 10 }
        }
        oe_rr_add_hope = { amount = 3 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ti_law_last value = var:oe_ti_target }
        trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ti.21 days = 1 }
    }
    remove_variable = oe_ti_target
    remove_variable = oe_ti_law_lock
}
# BYZ scope. Contract (SENATE): the senate dropped issue 4.
oe_tsn_reject_4 = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ti_target ?= { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } }
        var:oe_ti_target = {
            oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = -5 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ti_law_cd years = 5 }
            remove_variable = oe_ti_law_pending
        }
    }
    remove_variable = oe_ti_target
    remove_variable = oe_ti_law_lock
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3. despotate
# Theme scope. Records the current ruler as the despot (and the despot's dynasty).
oe_ti_despot_record = {
    ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_ti_rec_char }
    set_variable = oe_ti_despot_on
    set_variable = { name = oe_ti_despot value = scope:oe_ti_rec_char }
    remove_variable = oe_ti_despot_dyn
    if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_ti_rec_char = { has_dynasty = yes } }
        scope:oe_ti_rec_char = { dynasty = { save_scope_as = oe_ti_rec_dyn } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ti_despot_dyn value = scope:oe_ti_rec_dyn }
    }
    remove_variable = oe_ti_q_heir
    remove_variable = oe_ti_heir_open
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_ti_dsp_char becomes despot of scope:oe_ti_dsp_theme. Same steps as oe_tg_install
# (gen_theme_houses.py): move to the theme, set_new_ruler, the strategos trait, the displaced ruler back to court.
oe_ti_install_despot = {
    scope:oe_ti_dsp_theme = { ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_ti_dsp_old } }
    scope:oe_ti_dsp_char = { move_country = scope:oe_ti_dsp_theme }
    scope:oe_ti_dsp_theme = { set_new_ruler = scope:oe_ti_dsp_char }
    if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_ti_dsp_theme = { exists = ruler ruler = scope:oe_ti_dsp_char } }
        scope:oe_ti_dsp_char = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = oe_character_war_score_trait_VI } } add_trait = trait:oe_character_war_score_trait_VI } }
        scope:oe_ti_dsp_old ?= {
            if = { limit = { is_alive = yes NOT = { this = scope:oe_ti_dsp_char } NOT = { oe_nf_theme_governor = yes } } remove_trait = trait:oe_character_war_score_trait_VI }
            if = { limit = { is_alive = yes is_ruler = no } move_country = c:BYZ reset_ruler_title = {} }
        }
        scope:oe_ti_dsp_theme = {
            oe_ts_set_status = { status = 5 }
            oe_ti_despot_record = yes
        }
        oe_court_clear_invalid = yes
        oe_court_auto_fill = yes
        oe_nf_refresh = yes
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_ti_dsp_theme and scope:oe_ti_dsp_char set. The action 'grant a despotate' (also the AI path).
oe_ti_grant_despotate_do = {
    oe_ti_install_despot = yes
    if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_ti_dsp_theme = { var:oe_theme_status ?= 5 } }
        oe_ti_auth = { amount = -10 }
        add_prestige = -10
        set_variable = { name = oe_ti_dsp_last value = scope:oe_ti_dsp_theme }
        trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ti.30 days = 1 }
    }
}
# Theme scope. The despotate ends: back to the heartland.
oe_ti_despot_end = {
    oe_ts_set_status = { status = 1 }
    remove_variable = oe_ti_despot_on
    remove_variable = oe_ti_despot
    remove_variable = oe_ti_despot_dyn
    remove_variable = oe_ti_heir_open
    remove_variable = oe_ti_q_heir
    remove_variable = oe_ti_q_covet
}
# Theme scope. The despot is recalled to court; revolt risk through the theme revolt pipeline (gen_theme_revolt_works.py).
oe_ti_recall = {
    oe_ts_replace_strategos = yes
    scope:oe_ts_old_strategos ?= {
        if = { limit = { is_alive = yes NOT = { oe_nf_theme_governor = yes } } remove_trait = trait:oe_character_war_score_trait_VI }
    }
    oe_ti_despot_end = yes
    oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = -15 }
    random = { chance = oe_ti_recall_risk set_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now }
}
# Theme scope, monthly. Watches a despotate: adopts a despot set elsewhere (status 5 without a record), queues
# oe_ti.31 when the despot is gone. The flag oe_ti_despot_on does not depend on the character reference surviving.
oe_ti_despot_watch = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ti_despot_on } exists = ruler }
        oe_ti_despot_record = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ti_despot_on NOT = { oe_ti_despot_ok = yes } NOT = { has_variable = oe_ti_heir_open } }
        set_variable = oe_ti_q_heir
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 4. soldier settlers

# Theme scope. Soldier settlers, foreign: 20 years; unrest in the first 5 years; once in 30 years.
oe_ti_settle_foreign = {
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ti_settlers_foreign years = 20 mode = replace }
    every_owned_foreign_building_location = {
        limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ }
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ti_settlers_foreign_loc years = 20 mode = replace }
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ti_settlers_unrest_foreign years = 5 mode = replace }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ti_settlers years = 20 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ti_settlers_new years = 5 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ti_settle_cd years = 30 }
}

    every_owned_foreign_building_location = {
        limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ }
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ti_settlers_native_loc years = 20 mode = replace }
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ti_settlers_unrest_native years = 5 mode = replace }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ti_settlers years = 20 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ti_settlers_new years = 5 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ti_settle_cd years = 30 }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 5. pronoia
# Theme scope; needs scope:oe_ti_stage. Puts the stage modifier on the theme and its jurisdiction.
oe_ti_pronoia_apply = {
    remove_country_modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_s1 remove_country_modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_s2 remove_country_modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_s3 remove_country_modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_s4
    if = { limit = { scope:oe_ti_stage = 1 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_s1 years = -1 mode = replace } }
    if = { limit = { scope:oe_ti_stage = 2 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_s2 years = -1 mode = replace } }
    if = { limit = { scope:oe_ti_stage = 3 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_s3 years = -1 mode = replace } }
    if = { limit = { scope:oe_ti_stage = 4 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_s4 years = -1 mode = replace } }
    every_owned_foreign_building_location = {
        limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ }
        remove_location_modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_loc_s1 remove_location_modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_loc_s2 remove_location_modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_loc_s3 remove_location_modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_loc_s4
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_ti_stage = 1 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_loc_s1 months = 7 mode = replace } } if = { limit = { scope:oe_ti_stage = 2 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_loc_s2 months = 7 mode = replace } } if = { limit = { scope:oe_ti_stage = 3 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_loc_s3 months = 7 mode = replace } } if = { limit = { scope:oe_ti_stage = 4 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_loc_s4 months = 7 mode = replace } }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ti_pronoia_refresh months = 6 }
}
# Theme scope. Contract: the province's revenues are granted as pronoia (the officials menu sets oe_theme_fiscal = 3
# and calls this). Safe to call twice: the 20-year clock restarts.
oe_ti_pronoia_set = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ti_pronoia_months value = 0 }
    remove_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_hereditary
    remove_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_asked
    remove_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_postponed
    remove_variable = oe_ti_q_pronoia
    set_variable = { name = oe_ti_pronoia_inf_cd months = 12 }
    c:BYZ = { save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_ti_stage value = oe_ti_pronoia_stage } }
    oe_ti_pronoia_apply = yes
}
# Theme scope. Contract: the grants are taken back (the officials menu calls this when it leaves fiscal 3). A
# hereditary grant costs loyalty by the policy in force. Does nothing when the province has no grants.
oe_ti_pronoia_unset = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_months }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_hereditary }
            if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { has_policy = palaeologan_hereditary_transition } } oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = -20 } }
            else_if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { has_policy = reformed_pronoia_system } } oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = -10 } }
            else = { oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = -15 } }
        }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_s1 remove_country_modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_s2 remove_country_modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_s3 remove_country_modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_s4
        every_owned_foreign_building_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } remove_location_modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_loc_s1 remove_location_modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_loc_s2 remove_location_modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_loc_s3 remove_location_modifier = oe_ti_pronoia_loc_s4 }
        remove_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_months
        remove_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_hereditary
        remove_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_asked
        remove_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_postponed
        remove_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_refresh
        remove_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_inf_cd
        remove_variable = oe_ti_q_pronoia
    }
}
# Theme scope, monthly; needs scope:oe_ti_stage.
oe_ti_pronoia_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_theme_fiscal ?= 3 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_months } } oe_ti_pronoia_set = yes }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ti_pronoia_months add = 1 }
        if = { limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_refresh } oe_ti_pronoia_stage_changed = yes } } oe_ti_pronoia_apply = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_inf_cd } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ti_pronoia_inf_cd months = 12 }
            if = { limit = { oe_tg_house_born = yes } oe_ti_house_inf = { amount = 5 } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_months
                var:oe_ti_pronoia_months >= 240
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_hereditary }
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_asked }
            }
            set_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_asked
            set_variable = oe_ti_q_pronoia
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_months }
        oe_ti_pronoia_unset = yes
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- pulses
# Theme scope, monthly (from the BYZ pulse; scope:oe_ti_stage is set).
oe_ti_theme_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ti_law_basic = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_ti_prob_seen } }
        set_variable = oe_ti_prob_seen
        set_variable = { name = oe_ti_probation years = 15 }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_ti_seditious years = 10 } }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ti_weak_front NOT = { oe_ts_core = yes } }
        oe_ti_weak_front_clear = yes
        remove_variable = oe_ti_front_refused
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_ts_despot = yes } oe_ti_despot_watch = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_ti_despot_on has_variable = oe_ti_despot has_variable = oe_ti_q_heir has_variable = oe_ti_q_covet } }
        remove_variable = oe_ti_despot_on
        remove_variable = oe_ti_despot
        remove_variable = oe_ti_despot_dyn
        remove_variable = oe_ti_heir_open
        remove_variable = oe_ti_q_heir
        remove_variable = oe_ti_q_covet
    }
    oe_ti_pronoia_monthly = yes
}
# BYZ scope, every January.
oe_ti_byz_january = {
    every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } oe_ti_front_check = yes }
    if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } oe_ti_ai_yearly = yes }
}
# BYZ scope, monthly (on_action oe_ti_byz_pulse).
oe_ti_byz_monthly = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_ti_stage value = oe_ti_pronoia_stage }
    every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } oe_ti_theme_monthly = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ti_throne_unsettled = yes }
        every_subject = {
            limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_ts_despot = yes oe_ti_despot_ok = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_ti_covet_cd } }
            random = { chance = 3 set_variable = { name = oe_ti_covet_cd years = 10 } set_variable = oe_ti_q_covet }
        }
    }
    # Third round T2: once per game, marches are set without asking (the first January asked about every border theme).
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ti_front_init } }
        set_variable = oe_ti_front_init
        every_subject = {
            limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes }
            oe_ts_init_status = yes
            if = { limit = { oe_ts_core = yes NOT = { oe_ts_course_civil = yes } oe_ti_borders_foreign = yes } oe_ti_make_frontier = yes }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_ti_byz_january = yes }
    oe_ti_dispatch = yes
}
# BYZ scope. Fires one queued event of each kind a month (each event picks one queued province; the rest wait).
oe_ti_dispatch = {
    if = { limit = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_ti_q_front } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_ti } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_ti value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_ti add = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ti.1 }
    if = { limit = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_ti_q_quiet } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_ti } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_ti value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_ti add = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ti.2 }
    if = { limit = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_ti_q_heir } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_ti } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_ti value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_ti add = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ti.31 }
    if = { limit = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_ti_q_covet } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_ti } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_ti value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_ti add = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ti.32 }
    if = { limit = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_ti_q_pronoia } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_ti } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_ti value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_ti add = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ti.50 }
}

# BYZ scope, every January when Byzantium is AI.
oe_ti_ai_yearly = {
    # Roman law for the most loyal eligible province
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ti_law_can_request = yes international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { has_variable = oe_pillars_authority var:oe_pillars_authority >= 15 } any_subject = { oe_ti_law_eligible = yes } }
        ordered_subject = { limit = { oe_ti_law_eligible = yes } order_by = oe_ti_loyalty_key save_scope_as = oe_ti_law_theme }
        oe_ti_law_request = yes
    }
    # a despotate for a prince
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_ti_can_grant_despotate = yes
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { has_variable = oe_pillars_authority var:oe_pillars_authority >= 30 }
            oe_ti_despot_count < 2
            any_subject = { oe_ti_despotate_target = yes }
            any_character = { oe_ti_despot_candidate = yes }
        }
        random = {
            chance = 15
            random_subject = { limit = { oe_ti_despotate_target = yes } save_scope_as = oe_ti_dsp_theme }
            ordered_character = { limit = { oe_ti_despot_candidate = yes is_eligible_heir_baseline = scope:oe_ti_dsp_theme } order_by = age_in_years save_scope_as = oe_ti_dsp_char }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ti_dsp_char } oe_ti_grant_despotate_do = yes }
        }
    }
    # recall a despot in the treason band
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ti_can_recall = yes any_subject = { oe_ti_recall_target = yes var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 0 } }
        random = {
            chance = 30
            random_subject = { limit = { oe_ti_recall_target = yes var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 0 } save_scope_as = oe_ti_rc_theme }
            oe_ti_auth = { amount = -5 }
            scope:oe_ti_rc_theme = { oe_ti_recall = yes }
        }
    }
    # soldier settlers
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ti_can_settle = yes gold >= 400 any_subject = { oe_ti_settle_ok = yes } NOT = { has_variable = oe_ti_settle_target } }
        random = {
            chance = 25
            random_subject = { limit = { oe_ti_settle_ok = yes } save_scope_as = oe_ti_st_theme }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ti_settle_target value = scope:oe_ti_st_theme }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ti.40
        }
    }
    # pronoia for an army march or exarchate
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ti_pronoia_allowed = yes any_subject = { oe_ti_pronoia_ai_target = yes } }
        random = {
            chance = 10
            random_subject = {
                limit = { oe_ti_pronoia_ai_target = yes }
                set_variable = { name = oe_theme_fiscal value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_theme_officials_cd years = 2 }
                set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty
                oe_ti_pronoia_set = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- test helpers (dev mod buttons and console)
# BYZ scope. The province under test: var oe_ti_test_theme (the dev mod copies var:oe_dev_t into it), else a random one.
oe_ti_test_pick = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ti_test_theme ?= { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } }
        var:oe_ti_test_theme = { save_scope_as = oe_ti_tt }
    }
    else = {
        random_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes NOT = { tag = BYT01 } } save_scope_as = oe_ti_tt }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ti_tt } set_variable = { name = oe_ti_test_theme value = scope:oe_ti_tt } }
    }
}
oe_ti_test_front = {
    oe_ti_test_pick = yes
    scope:oe_ti_tt ?= { if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_ts_core = yes } } oe_ts_set_status = { status = 1 } } remove_variable = oe_ti_front_refused set_variable = oe_ti_q_front }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ti.1
}
oe_ti_test_quiet = {
    oe_ti_test_pick = yes
    scope:oe_ti_tt ?= { oe_ts_set_status = { status = 2 } set_variable = oe_ti_origin_core set_variable = { name = oe_ti_quiet value = 5 } set_variable = oe_ti_q_quiet }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ti.2
}
oe_ti_test_law_ready = {
    oe_ti_test_pick = yes
    remove_variable = oe_ti_law_lock
    scope:oe_ti_tt ?= {
        if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { oe_ts_frontier = yes oe_ts_exarch = yes oe_ts_charter = yes } } } oe_ts_set_status = { status = 2 } }
        remove_variable = oe_ti_origin_core
        set_variable = oe_ti_prob_seen
        remove_variable = oe_ti_probation
        remove_variable = oe_ti_seditious
        remove_variable = oe_ti_law_cd
        remove_variable = oe_ti_law_pending
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty value = 75 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty_band value = 3 }
    }
}
oe_ti_test_law_apply = { oe_ti_test_pick = yes if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ti_tt } set_variable = { name = oe_ti_target value = scope:oe_ti_tt } oe_tsn_apply_4 = yes } }
oe_ti_test_law_reject = { oe_ti_test_pick = yes if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ti_tt } set_variable = { name = oe_ti_target value = scope:oe_ti_tt } oe_tsn_reject_4 = yes } }
oe_ti_test_despot = {
    oe_ti_test_pick = yes
    scope:oe_ti_tt ?= { if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_ts_core = yes } } oe_ts_set_status = { status = 1 } } save_scope_as = oe_ti_dsp_theme }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_ti_dsp_theme }
        ordered_character = { limit = { oe_ti_despot_candidate = yes is_eligible_heir_baseline = scope:oe_ti_dsp_theme } order_by = age_in_years save_scope_as = oe_ti_dsp_char }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ti_dsp_char } oe_ti_auth = { amount = 10 } oe_ti_grant_despotate_do = yes }
    }
}
oe_ti_test_despot_gone = {
    oe_ti_test_pick = yes
    c:BYZ.ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_ti_tmp_char }
    scope:oe_ti_tt ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { oe_ts_despot = yes exists = scope:oe_ti_tmp_char }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ti_despot value = scope:oe_ti_tmp_char }
            remove_variable = oe_ti_heir_open
            set_variable = oe_ti_q_heir
        }
    }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ti.31
}
oe_ti_test_covet = { oe_ti_test_pick = yes scope:oe_ti_tt ?= { if = { limit = { oe_ts_despot = yes } set_variable = oe_ti_q_covet } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_ti } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_ti value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_ti add = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ti.32 }
oe_ti_test_pronoia = { oe_ti_test_pick = yes scope:oe_ti_tt ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_theme_fiscal value = 3 } set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty oe_ti_pronoia_set = yes } }
oe_ti_test_pronoia_20y = { oe_ti_test_pick = yes scope:oe_ti_tt ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_months } set_variable = { name = oe_ti_pronoia_months value = 239 } remove_variable = oe_ti_pronoia_asked } } }
oe_ti_test_settle = {
    oe_ti_test_pick = yes
    scope:oe_ti_tt ?= { remove_variable = oe_ti_settle_cd }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ti_tt } set_variable = { name = oe_ti_settle_target value = scope:oe_ti_tt } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ti.40 }
}
oe_ti_test_january = { save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_ti_stage value = oe_ti_pronoia_stage } oe_ti_byz_january = yes oe_ti_dispatch = yes }
oe_ti_test_reset = {
    oe_ti_test_pick = yes
    remove_variable = oe_ti_law_lock
    remove_variable = oe_ti_target
    remove_variable = oe_ti_settle_target
    scope:oe_ti_tt ?= {
        oe_ti_weak_front_clear = yes
        remove_variable = oe_ti_origin_core
        remove_variable = oe_ti_quiet
        remove_variable = oe_ti_front_refused
        remove_variable = oe_ti_q_front
        remove_variable = oe_ti_q_quiet
        remove_variable = oe_ti_prob_seen
        remove_variable = oe_ti_probation
        remove_variable = oe_ti_seditious
        remove_variable = oe_ti_law_cd
        remove_variable = oe_ti_law_pending
        remove_variable = oe_ti_q_heir
        remove_variable = oe_ti_heir_open
        remove_variable = oe_ti_q_covet
        remove_variable = oe_ti_covet_cd
        remove_variable = oe_ti_settle_cd
        remove_variable = oe_ti_q_pronoia
    }
}
